scripts.install:all: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix server --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix client --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Server,Client" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
